# T-1: Add prompt cache storage

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Provide flow-local or spec-local cache storage for Agent.call responses and deterministic cache-key calculation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R2 is satisfied by deterministic sha256 key calculation over all required identity fields including resolved invocation identity.
- R6 is satisfied by cache storage that resolves only from the active flow current-spec artifact and is disabled when no active flow/current spec is resolved.

## Implementation Notes
Use Node.js built-in crypto and filesystem APIs only. Resolve cache storage through FlowManager active-flow/current-spec context. Keep cache storage bounded to one current-flow/current-spec artifact and avoid scanning all specs or prompt logs. Do not add a non-active spec-local cache path unless a concrete scope input is introduced.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local tests with `// spec: R2 ...` and `// spec: R6 ...` headers for stable key fields and cross-flow/spec isolation.
